notes: Paths are repository-relative unless evidence_root is explicit. No flag confers eligibility. Every pregame/terminal receipt needs source_id, upstream_lineage_id, source_url, retrieved_utc, body_path, response_sha256 and event_lineage_audit {path,sha256}. Audits bind exact raw response, event and collector. Distribution artifacts use score-distribution-1 and bind event_id, endpoint, model_version, data_cutoff_utc, input_checksum and integer score states. Commit is disabled by default; native scheduled times never substitute for verified actual start.
